method: static scan of frozen production modules for latest-completed/finished-at selection patterns, followed by explicit classification

findings.snippet: ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.created_at DESC
findings.reason: Book QA V2 run listing ordered by run finish time; returns run metadata for an authenticated, explicitly scoped QA feature. It is not used by document/viewer/source/search/citation resolution and never decides normal document visibility.

findings.snippet: ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
findings.reason: get_latest_book_qa_run(document_id=...) is only reachable from the authenticated Book QA discovery endpoints with an explicit document_id and no run_id. It selects a QA ingestion run, not a visible document. The Foundation test asserts it does not feed the viewer.

findings.snippet: "SELECT * FROM library_document_texts WHERE document_id = %(document_id)s ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1",
findings.reason: Selects the newest extraction text row for an explicit physical document_id. It does not select a document or generation and has no production call site in the frozen tree.

findings.snippet: from "the most recent completed run". A candidate generation that completes
findings.reason: Docstring states that the historical most-recent-completed-run rule is forbidden; implementation uses the ACTIVE pointer.

findings.snippet: It is never inferred from ``created_at``, ``finished_at``, "latest completed run"
findings.reason: Docstring states the normative rule: the active generation is never inferred from created_at, finished_at or the latest completed run.
